meta.source: curated offline sample set for demonstration
meta.note: not exhaustive; use --online for live NVD lookups

openssh.summary: OpenSSH allows remote attackers to test whether a username is valid via timing of authentication responses (user enumeration).
OpenSSH sshd allows remote user enumeration via covert timing when using very long passwords.
OpenSSH client information leak enabling a man-in-the-middle to fingerprint host key algorithm negotiation.

apache httpd.summary: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 via crafted URLs.
Path traversal leading to remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50 (incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773).
Apache HTTP Server privilege escalation from modules scripts to parent process on Unix.

nginx.summary: Stack buffer overflow in nginx when handling chunked Transfer-Encoding requests.
nginx error_page request smuggling allowing HTTP request smuggling in some configurations.

vsftpd.summary: vsftpd 2.3.4 shipped with a backdoor that opens a command shell on port 6200.

proftpd.summary: ProFTPD mod_copy allows unauthenticated remote users to read and write arbitrary files via SITE CPFR/CPTO.

exim.summary: Exim allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code as root via a trailing backslash in the TLS SNI.
Exim remote command execution via crafted recipient address in deliver_message (The Return of the WIZard).

samba.summary: Samba remote code execution by uploading a shared library to a writable share and causing the server to load it (SambaCry).

openssl.summary: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat read overrun exposes process memory to a remote attacker (Heartbleed).

microsoft-iis.summary: Buffer overflow in the WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl in IIS 6.0 allows remote code execution.

redis.summary: Debian/Ubuntu Redis Lua sandbox escape allowing remote code execution.

memcached.summary: Memcached UDP support enables large-scale reflection/amplification denial-of-service attacks.
